news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) placed on Injured Reserve
news.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on Injured Reserve.
news.impact: Robinson has missed the last several games with a hamstring injury, and apparently hasn't made enough progress for the team to keep him off of IR. He will miss at least the next four games. The Falcons will need to elevate someone to back up Bijan Robinson.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Pat Bryant (ankle) activated off of IR
news.desc: Pat Bryant (ankle) has been activated from injured reserve ahead of Denver's game against the Panthers on Sunday.
news.impact: Bryant is still officially questionable, but his activation indicates that he will play on Sunday. He'll be a tough start in his first game back, but could have some flex appeal in later weeks.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Kendre Miller released by the Saints
news.desc: Kendre Miller has been released by the New Orleans Saints.
news.impact: Miller had his moments, but could never string anything together during his injury-riddled career in New Orleans. He didn't seem to endear himself to coaching staff's either, as multiple different coaches passed over him for the starting job unless they had no other option. He will look to find a new home elsewhere.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Baltimore Ravens D/ST struggle against Jacksonville
news.desc: The Baltimore Ravens D/ST was run over by the Jaguars on Thursday, allowing 33 points in the 23-point loss. They did manage a fumble recovery, but that was the only real counting stat they managed.
news.impact: It was a rough showing by the Ravens' unit, but they weren't helped by the offense, which often gave the Jaguars short fields to work with, putting more pressure on the defense. They will look to get things back on track against the Chargers.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Jake Moody hits four kicking points in loss
news.desc: Jake Moody hit his only field goal and PAT attempts in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to Jacksonville on Thursday,
news.impact: Moody filled in well for the injured Tyler Loop, but didn't get much of a chance to put points on the board. Hopefully things will improve for the Ravens in the coming weeks.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Justice Hill breaks away for long TD in loss
news.desc: Justice Hill ran nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday. He also caught three passes for seven yards.
news.impact: Hill managed the one explosive play by the Ravens all night, breaking away for a long touchdown late in the game. He could be an interesting flex option moving forward as the Ravens change of pace back.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Ja'Kobi Lane held without a catch in loss
news.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane was held without a catch in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.impact: Lane has only one catch in the last two games, but it's hard to take away much from Thursday's game, where the Ravens only had 10 completions, and their leading receiver had only 19 yards. So don't lose hope on Lane just yet.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Rashod Bateman hauls in short pass in loss
news.desc: Rashod Bateman caught one of two targets for six yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.impact: Bateman has two catches in as many weeks, and he's fallen out of relevance for fantasy. Leave him on waivers until he shows some sort of value.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Mark Andrews snags two passes in loss
news.desc: Mark Andrews caught both of his targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.impact: Andrews led the Ravens in receiving yards in the blowout loss, not that it meant much for fantasy. He's been tough to trust at any point this season and is safe to leave on the waiver wire. However, if you want to hold on and see what he might do with Jacoby Brissett at QB, there's merit to that.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Zay Flowers manages 23 yards in loss to Jags
news.desc: Zay Flowers caught three of six targets for 6 yards and ran three times for 17 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.impact: Flowers had three more catches than he had on Sunday, but it didn't amount to much. Jacoby Brissett should bring back some life to the fantasy value of Flowers once he takes the reins of the offense, and thankfully that should come next week.
